cond_0001.intro: Your mission is to design, develop, and implement efficient production systems that will improve profitability and safety. You will use your years of experience with production processes, process flow, capacity planning, inventory management, and Lean Manufacturing principles to increase efficiency. Your excellent problem-solving skills will help you troubleshoot issues within the facility, and your strong written and verbal communication skills will help you build trusting relationships with Maintenance, Manufacturing, Shipping/Receiving, and elsewhere in the company.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITES:
Design, develop, and implement efficient production systems that optimize the use of resources and minimize waste.
Work closely with product engineering and production teams to identify areas of improvement and develop solutions to enhance productivity, quality, and cost.
Conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) on production issues to identify the underlying cause of problems and develop solutions to prevent recurrence.
Develop and maintain standard operating procedures (S&OPs) for all production processes and conduct time studies to identify bottlenecks and inefficiencies in the production process with the method engineer.
Work with human resources to develop and implement training programs for production staff to ensure they are equipped with the necessary skills to perform their jobs effectively.
Ensure compliance with all safety regulations and company policies.
Create detailed drawings of production systems and equipment to aid in troubleshooting and maintenance.
Develops and maintain documentation for all production processes, including process flow diagrams, work instructions, and training materials.
ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:
Optimize work sequencing and workflow through machines/work centers.
Develop and issue Manufacturing Engineering policies and procedures.
Provide budgeting information and project updates/status to management.
Design of layouts and line flow.
Coordinate implementation of approved facility changes with Manufacturing.
Conduct workflow, capacity, and throughput analyses.
Conduct cost analysis as required.
Champion and apply Lean Tools (5S, Kaizen, Root Cause Analysis); monitor effectiveness.
Participate and/or Facilitate Kaizen events and train others on how to facilitate them.
Measure Lean implementation results.
Execute and promote problem-solving at all levels of the organization.
Office computer program literacy, and experience using calipers, micrometers, and measuring equipment are required to perform the duties of this position.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements:
A bachelor's degree in mechanical, industrial, electrical, avionics, or manufacturing engineering
Minimum of 5 years of manufacturing engineering experience

You will apply experience with production processes, process flow, capacity planning, inventory management, and Lean Manufacturing principles to increase efficiency. Strong problem-solving skills are needed to troubleshoot facility issues, along with clear written and verbal communication to coordinate with Maintenance, Manufacturing, Shipping/Receiving, and other internal teams.
cond_0043.responsibilities:
PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:
Design, develop, and implement efficient production systems that optimize resource use and minimize waste.
Coordinate with product engineering and production teams to identify areas of improvement and develop solutions to enhance productivity, quality, and cost.
Conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) on production issues to identify underlying causes and develop solutions to prevent recurrence.
Develop and maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs) for all production processes and conduct time studies with the method engineer to identify bottlenecks and inefficiencies.
Coordinate with human resources to develop and implement training programs for production staff.
Ensure compliance with all safety regulations and company policies.
Create detailed drawings of production systems and equipment to support troubleshooting and maintenance.
Develop and maintain documentation for all production processes, including process flow diagrams, work instructions, and training materials.
ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:
Optimize work sequencing and workflow through machines and work centers.
Develop and issue Manufacturing Engineering policies and procedures.
Provide budgeting information and project status updates to management.
Design layouts and line flow.
Coordinate implementation of approved facility changes with Manufacturing.
Conduct workflow, capacity, and throughput analyses.
Conduct cost analysis as required.
Apply Lean Tools (5S, Kaizen, Root Cause Analysis) and monitor effectiveness.
Participate in and facilitate Kaizen events; train others on facilitation.
Measure Lean implementation results.
Support problem-solving at all levels of the organization.
Use office computer programs and measuring equipment including calipers, micrometers, and related tools.
cond_0043.requirements:
Minimum Requirements:
Bachelor's degree in mechanical, industrial, electrical, avionics, or manufacturing engineering
Minimum of 5 years of manufacturing engineering experience
Preferred Requirements:
Familiarity with process flow, capacity planning, and inventory management
Experience with Lean Manufacturing principles and tools (5S, Kaizen, RCA)
Proficiency with office computer programs and hands-on measuring equipment (calipers, micrometers)

cond_0053.intro: Your mission is to design, develop, and implement efficient production systems that will improve profitability and safety. You will draw on your experience with production processes, process flow, capacity planning, inventory management, and Lean Manufacturing principles to drive efficiency. Your problem-solving skills will help you troubleshoot issues within the facility, and your written and verbal communication skills will help you build trusting relationships with Maintenance, Manufacturing, Shipping/Receiving, and elsewhere in the company.
cond_0053.responsibilities:
PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:
Design, develop, and implement efficient production systems that optimize the use of resources and minimize waste.
Lead collaboration with product engineering and production teams to identify areas of improvement and develop solutions to enhance productivity, quality, and cost.
Conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) on production issues to determine the underlying cause of problems and develop solutions to prevent recurrence.
Develop and maintain standard operating procedures (S&OPs) for all production processes and execute time studies to identify bottlenecks and inefficiencies in the production process with the method engineer.
Direct the development and implementation of training programs with human resources for production staff to ensure they are equipped with the necessary skills to perform their jobs effectively.
Ensure compliance with all safety regulations and company policies.
Create detailed drawings of production systems and equipment to aid in troubleshooting and maintenance.
Develop and maintain documentation for all production processes, including process flow diagrams, work instructions, and training materials.
ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:
Optimize work sequencing and workflow through machines/work centers.
Develop and issue Manufacturing Engineering policies and procedures.
Provide budgeting information and project updates/status to management.
Direct the design of layouts and line flow.
Own implementation of approved facility changes with Manufacturing.
Conduct workflow, capacity, and throughput analyses.
Conduct cost analysis as required.
Champion and apply Lean Tools (5S, Kaizen, Root Cause Analysis); monitor effectiveness.
Lead and facilitate Kaizen events and train others on how to facilitate them.
Measure Lean implementation results.
Execute and promote problem-solving at all levels of the organization.
Office computer program literacy, and experience using calipers, micrometers, and measuring equipment are required to perform the duties of this position.

In this role, you will work with production, maintenance, shipping/receiving, and other teams to design and implement efficient production systems that improve profitability and safety. Your experience with production processes, process flow, capacity planning, inventory management, and Lean Manufacturing will help the team increase efficiency. Your problem-solving and communication skills will support strong working relationships across the facility.
cond_0063.responsibilities:
PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:
Coordinate with product engineering and production teams to design, develop, and implement efficient production systems that optimize resource use and minimize waste.
Work alongside product engineering and production teams to identify areas of improvement and develop solutions to enhance productivity, quality, and cost.
Conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) on production issues together with relevant teams to identify underlying causes and develop solutions to prevent recurrence.
Develop and maintain standard operating procedures (S&OPs) for all production processes, and work with the method engineer to conduct time studies to identify bottlenecks and inefficiencies.
Coordinate with human resources to develop and implement training programs for production staff to ensure they have the skills needed to perform their jobs effectively.
Support compliance with all safety regulations and company policies.
Create detailed drawings of production systems and equipment to assist in troubleshooting and maintenance.
Develop and maintain documentation for all production processes, including process flow diagrams, work instructions, and training materials.
ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:
Optimize work sequencing and workflow through machines/work centers.
Develop and issue Manufacturing Engineering policies and procedures.
Share budgeting information and project updates/status with management.
Support design of layouts and line flow.
Coordinate implementation of approved facility changes with Manufacturing.
Conduct workflow, capacity, and throughput analyses.
Conduct cost analysis as required.
Champion and apply Lean Tools (5S, Kaizen, Root Cause Analysis); monitor effectiveness.
Participate in and/or facilitate Kaizen events and help others learn how to facilitate them.
Measure Lean implementation results.
Support and promote problem-solving at all levels of the organization.
Office computer program literacy, and experience using calipers, micrometers, and measuring equipment are required to perform the duties of this position.
cond_0063.requirements:
Minimum Requirements:
Bachelor's degree in mechanical, industrial, electrical, avionics, or manufacturing engineering
Minimum of 5 years of manufacturing engineering experience
Preferred Requirements:
Familiarity with Lean Manufacturing tools and principles (5S, Kaizen, Root Cause Analysis)
Experience with capacity planning, process flow, and inventory management
Strong written and verbal communication skills
Experience using calipers, micrometers, and other measuring equipment

cond_0096.intro: Your mission is to design, develop, and implement efficient production systems that improve profitability and safety. You will bring years of experience with production processes, process flow, capacity planning, inventory management, and Lean Manufacturing principles to increase efficiency. Your problem-solving skills will help you troubleshoot issues within the facility, and your strong written and verbal communication skills will help you build trusting relationships with Maintenance, Manufacturing, Shipping/Receiving, and others across the company.
cond_0096.responsibilities:
PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:
Design, develop, and implement efficient production systems that optimize the use of resources and minimize waste.
Work closely with product engineering and production teams daily to identify areas of improvement and develop solutions to enhance productivity, quality, and cost.
Conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) on production issues to identify the underlying cause of problems and develop solutions to prevent recurrence.
Develop and maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs) for all production processes and conduct time studies to identify bottlenecks and inefficiencies, working directly with the method engineer.
Work with human resources to develop and implement training programs for production staff, ensuring they have the skills to perform their jobs effectively.
Ensure compliance with all safety regulations and company policies.
Create detailed drawings of production systems and equipment to aid in troubleshooting and maintenance.
Develop and maintain documentation for all production processes, including process flow diagrams, work instructions, and training materials.
ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:
Optimize work sequencing and workflow through machines/work centers.
Develop and issue Manufacturing Engineering policies and procedures.
Provide budgeting information and project updates/status to management.
Design layouts and line flow.
Coordinate implementation of approved facility changes with Manufacturing.
Conduct workflow, capacity, and throughput analyses.
Conduct cost analysis as required.
Champion and apply Lean Tools (5S, Kaizen, Root Cause Analysis); monitor effectiveness.
Participate in and facilitate Kaizen events and train others on how to facilitate them.
Measure Lean implementation results.
Execute and promote problem-solving at all levels of the organization.
Office computer program literacy, and experience using calipers, micrometers, and measuring equipment.
cond_0096.requirements:
Minimum Requirements:
Bachelor's degree in mechanical, industrial, electrical, avionics, or manufacturing engineering
Minimum of 5 years of manufacturing engineering experience
Preferred Requirements:
Familiarity with Lean Manufacturing tools and principles (5S, Kaizen, Root Cause Analysis)
Experience conducting time studies, capacity analyses, and workflow analyses
Experience developing SOPs, work instructions, and training materials
Experience using calipers, micrometers, and other measuring equipment

Your problem-solving skills will help you troubleshoot issues within the facility, and your written and verbal communication skills will help you build trusting relationships with Maintenance, Manufacturing, Shipping/Receiving, and elsewhere in the company.
cond_0152.responsibilities:
PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:
Design, develop, and implement efficient production systems that optimize the use of resources and minimize waste.
Lead collaboration with product engineering and production teams to identify areas of improvement and deliver solutions that enhance productivity, quality, and cost.
Conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) on production issues to determine the underlying cause of problems and develop solutions to prevent recurrence.
Develop and maintain standard operating procedures (S&OPs) for all production processes and execute time studies to identify bottlenecks and inefficiencies in the production process with the method engineer.
Direct the development and implementation of training programs for production staff in coordination with human resources to ensure they are equipped with the necessary skills to perform their jobs effectively.
Ensure compliance with all safety regulations and company policies.
Create detailed drawings of production systems and equipment to aid in troubleshooting and maintenance.
Develop and maintain documentation for all production processes, including process flow diagrams, work instructions, and training materials.
ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:
Optimize work sequencing and workflow through machines/work centers.
Develop and issue Manufacturing Engineering policies and procedures.
Provide budgeting information and project updates/status to management.
Direct the design of layouts and line flow.
Own the implementation of approved facility changes with Manufacturing.
Conduct workflow, capacity, and throughput analyses.
Conduct cost analysis as required.
Champion and apply Lean Tools (5S, Kaizen, Root Cause Analysis); monitor effectiveness.
Lead and facilitate Kaizen events and train others on how to facilitate them.
Measure Lean implementation results.
Execute and promote problem-solving at all levels of the organization.
Office computer program literacy, and experience using calipers, micrometers, and measuring equipment are required to perform the duties of this position.
cond_0152.requirements:
Minimum Requirements:
Bachelor's degree in mechanical, industrial, electrical, avionics, or manufacturing engineering
Minimum of 5 years of manufacturing engineering experience

Optimize work sequencing and workflow through machines/work centers.
Develop and issue Manufacturing Engineering policies and procedures.
Share budgeting information and project updates/status with management.
Support design of layouts and line flow.
Coordinate implementation of approved facility changes with Manufacturing.
Conduct workflow, capacity, and throughput analyses.
Conduct cost analysis as required.
Champion and apply Lean Tools (5S, Kaizen, Root Cause Analysis); monitor effectiveness.
Participate in and/or facilitate Kaizen events and help others learn how to facilitate them.
Measure Lean implementation results.
Support and promote problem-solving at all levels of the organization.
Office computer program literacy, and experience using calipers, micrometers, and measuring equipment are required to perform the duties of this position.

Bachelor's degree in mechanical, industrial, electrical, avionics, or manufacturing engineering
Minimum of 5 years of manufacturing engineering experience
Preferred Requirements:
Familiarity with Lean Manufacturing tools and principles (5S, Kaizen, Root Cause Analysis)
Experience with capacity planning, process flow, and inventory management

cond_0221.intro: Your mission is to design, develop, and implement efficient production systems that will improve profitability and safety. You will use your years of experience with production processes, process flow, capacity planning, inventory management, and Lean Manufacturing principles to increase efficiency. Your excellent problem-solving skills will help you troubleshoot issues within the facility, and your strong written and verbal communication skills will help you build trusting relationships with Maintenance, Manufacturing, Shipping/Receiving, and elsewhere in the company. People generally become stronger in this kind of manufacturing engineering work over time as they build hands-on experience and learn from real production challenges.
cond_0221.responsibilities:
PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITES:
Design, develop, and implement efficient production systems that optimize the use of resources and minimize waste.
Work closely with product engineering and production teams to identify areas of improvement and develop solutions to enhance productivity, quality, and cost.
Conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) on production issues to identify the underlying cause of problems and develop solutions to prevent recurrence.
Develop and maintain standard operating procedures (S&OPs) for all production processes and conduct time studies to identify bottlenecks and inefficiencies in the production process with the method engineer.
Work with human resources to develop and implement training programs for production staff to ensure they are equipped with the necessary skills to perform their jobs effectively.
Ensure compliance with all safety regulations and company policies.
Create detailed drawings of production systems and equipment to aid in troubleshooting and maintenance.
Develops and maintain documentation for all production processes, including process flow diagrams, work instructions, and training materials.
ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:
Optimize work sequencing and workflow through machines/work centers.
Develop and issue Manufacturing Engineering policies and procedures.
Provide budgeting information and project updates/status to management.
Design of layouts and line flow.
Coordinate implementation of approved facility changes with Manufacturing.
Conduct workflow, capacity, and throughput analyses.
Conduct cost analysis as required.
Champion and apply Lean Tools (5S, Kaizen, Root Cause Analysis); monitor effectiveness.
Participate and/or Facilitate Kaizen events and train others on how to facilitate them.
Measure Lean implementation results.
Execute and promote problem-solving at all levels of the organization.
Office computer program literacy, and experience using calipers, micrometers, and measuring equipment are required to perform the duties of this position.

Minimum Requirements:
A bachelor's degree in mechanical, industrial, electrical, avionics, or manufacturing engineering
Minimum of 5 years of manufacturing engineering experience

cond_0242.intro: Your mission is to design, develop, and implement efficient production systems that improve profitability and safety. You will draw on your experience with production processes, process flow, capacity planning, inventory management, and Lean Manufacturing principles to increase efficiency. Your problem-solving skills will help you troubleshoot issues within the facility, and your written and verbal communication skills will help you build trusting relationships with Maintenance, Manufacturing, Shipping/Receiving, and elsewhere in the company.
cond_0242.responsibilities:
PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:
Design, develop, and implement efficient production systems that optimize the use of resources and minimize waste.
Lead collaboration with product engineering and production teams to identify areas of improvement and deliver solutions that enhance productivity, quality, and cost.
Conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) on production issues to determine the underlying cause of problems and develop solutions to prevent recurrence.
Develop and maintain standard operating procedures (S&OPs) for all production processes and execute time studies to identify bottlenecks and inefficiencies in the production process with the method engineer.
Direct the development and implementation of training programs for production staff in coordination with human resources to ensure they are equipped with the necessary skills to perform their jobs effectively.
Ensure compliance with all safety regulations and company policies.
Create detailed drawings of production systems and equipment to aid in troubleshooting and maintenance.
Develop and maintain documentation for all production processes, including process flow diagrams, work instructions, and training materials.
ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:
Optimize work sequencing and workflow through machines/work centers.
Develop and issue Manufacturing Engineering policies and procedures.
Provide budgeting information and project updates/status to management.
Direct the design of layouts and line flow.
Own the implementation of approved facility changes with Manufacturing.
Conduct workflow, capacity, and throughput analyses.
Conduct cost analysis as required.
Champion and apply Lean Tools (5S, Kaizen, Root Cause Analysis); monitor effectiveness.
Lead and facilitate Kaizen events and train others on how to facilitate them.
Measure Lean implementation results.
Execute and promote problem-solving at all levels of the organization.
Office computer program literacy, and experience using calipers, micrometers, and measuring equipment are required to perform the duties of this position.
cond_0242.requirements:
Minimum Requirements:
Bachelor's degree in mechanical, industrial, electrical, avionics, or manufacturing engineering
Minimum of 5 years of manufacturing engineering experience

Your excellent problem-solving skills will help you troubleshoot issues within the facility, and your strong written and verbal communication skills will help you build trusting relationships with Maintenance, Manufacturing, Shipping/Receiving, and elsewhere in the company.
cond_0253.responsibilities:
PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITES:
Design, develop, and implement efficient production systems that optimize the use of resources and minimize waste.
Work closely with product engineering and production teams to identify areas of improvement and develop solutions to enhance productivity, quality, and cost.
Conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) on production issues to identify the underlying cause of problems and develop solutions to prevent recurrence.
Develop and maintain standard operating procedures (S&OPs) for all production processes and conduct time studies to identify bottlenecks and inefficiencies in the production process with the method engineer.
Work with human resources to develop and implement training programs for production staff to ensure they are equipped with the necessary skills to perform their jobs effectively.
Ensure compliance with all safety regulations and company policies.
Create detailed drawings of production systems and equipment to aid in troubleshooting and maintenance.
Develops and maintain documentation for all production processes, including process flow diagrams, work instructions, and training materials.
ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:
Optimize work sequencing and workflow through machines/work centers.
Develop and issue Manufacturing Engineering policies and procedures.
Provide budgeting information and project updates/status to management.
Design of layouts and line flow.
Coordinate implementation of approved facility changes with Manufacturing.
Conduct workflow, capacity, and throughput analyses.
Conduct cost analysis as required.
Champion and apply Lean Tools (5S, Kaizen, Root Cause Analysis); monitor effectiveness.
Participate and/or Facilitate Kaizen events and train others on how to facilitate them.
Measure Lean implementation results.
Execute and promote problem-solving at all levels of the organization.
Office computer program literacy, and experience using calipers, micrometers, and measuring equipment are required to perform the duties of this position.
cond_0253.requirements:
Minimum Requirements:
A bachelor's degree in mechanical, industrial, electrical, avionics, or manufacturing engineering
Minimum of 5 years of manufacturing engineering experience

cond_0263.intro: Your mission is to design, develop, and implement efficient production systems that will improve profitability and safety. You will use your years of experience with production processes, process flow, capacity planning, inventory management, and Lean Manufacturing principles to increase efficiency. Your excellent problem-solving skills will help you troubleshoot issues within the facility, and your strong written and verbal communication skills will help you build trusting relationships with Maintenance, Manufacturing, Shipping/Receiving, and elsewhere in the company.
cond_0263.responsibilities:
PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITES:
Design, develop, and implement efficient production systems that optimize the use of resources and minimize waste.
Work closely with product engineering and production teams to identify areas of improvement and develop solutions to enhance productivity, quality, and cost.
Conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) on production issues to identify the underlying cause of problems and develop solutions to prevent recurrence.
Develop and maintain standard operating procedures (S&OPs) for all production processes and conduct time studies to identify bottlenecks and inefficiencies in the production process with the method engineer.
Work with human resources to develop and implement training programs for production staff to ensure they are equipped with the necessary skills to perform their jobs effectively.
Ensure compliance with all safety regulations and company policies.
Create detailed drawings of production systems and equipment to aid in troubleshooting and maintenance.
Develops and maintain documentation for all production processes, including process flow diagrams, work instructions, and training materials.
ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:
Optimize work sequencing and workflow through machines/work centers.
Develop and issue Manufacturing Engineering policies and procedures.
Provide budgeting information and project updates/status to management.
Design of layouts and line flow.
Coordinate implementation of approved facility changes with Manufacturing.
Conduct workflow, capacity, and throughput analyses.
Conduct cost analysis as required.
Champion and apply Lean Tools (5S, Kaizen, Root Cause Analysis); monitor effectiveness.
Participate and/or Facilitate Kaizen events and train others on how to facilitate them.
Measure Lean implementation results.
Execute and promote problem-solving at all levels of the organization.
Office computer program literacy, and experience using calipers, micrometers, and measuring equipment are required to perform the duties of this position.

cond_0273.intro: Your mission is to design, develop, and implement efficient production systems that will improve profitability and safety. You will use your years of experience with production processes, process flow, capacity planning, inventory management, and Lean Manufacturing principles to increase efficiency. Your excellent problem-solving skills will help you troubleshoot issues within the facility, and your strong written and verbal communication skills will help you build trusting relationships with Maintenance, Manufacturing, Shipping/Receiving, and elsewhere in the company.
cond_0273.responsibilities:
PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITES:
Design, develop, and implement efficient production systems that optimize the use of resources and minimize waste.
Work closely with product engineering and production teams to identify areas of improvement and develop solutions to enhance productivity, quality, and cost.
Conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) on production issues to identify the underlying cause of problems and develop solutions to prevent recurrence.
Develop and maintain standard operating procedures (S&OPs) for all production processes and conduct time studies to identify bottlenecks and inefficiencies in the production process with the method engineer.
Work with human resources to develop and implement training programs for production staff to ensure they are equipped with the necessary skills to perform their jobs effectively.
Ensure compliance with all safety regulations and company policies.
Create detailed drawings of production systems and equipment to aid in troubleshooting and maintenance.
Develops and maintain documentation for all production processes, including process flow diagrams, work instructions, and training materials.
ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:
Optimize work sequencing and workflow through machines/work centers.
Develop and issue Manufacturing Engineering policies and procedures.
Provide budgeting information and project updates/status to management.
Design of layouts and line flow.
Coordinate implementation of approved facility changes with Manufacturing.
Conduct workflow, capacity, and throughput analyses.
Conduct cost analysis as required.
Champion and apply Lean Tools (5S, Kaizen, Root Cause Analysis); monitor effectiveness.
Participate and/or Facilitate Kaizen events and train others on how to facilitate them.
Measure Lean implementation results.
Execute and promote problem-solving at all levels of the organization.
Office computer program literacy, and experience using calipers, micrometers, and measuring equipment are required to perform the duties of this position.
cond_0273.requirements:
Minimum Requirements:
A bachelor's degree in mechanical, industrial, electrical, avionics, or manufacturing engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Preferred Requirements:
Around 5 years of manufacturing engineering experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

Your problem-solving skills will help you troubleshoot issues within the facility, and your strong written and verbal communication skills will help you build trusting relationships with Maintenance, Manufacturing, Shipping/Receiving, and others across the company.
cond_0294.responsibilities:
PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:
Design, develop, and implement efficient production systems that optimize the use of resources and minimize waste.
Work closely with product engineering and production teams daily to identify areas of improvement and develop solutions to enhance productivity, quality, and cost.
Conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) on production issues to identify the underlying cause of problems and develop solutions to prevent recurrence.
Develop and maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs) for all production processes and conduct time studies to identify bottlenecks and inefficiencies, working directly with the method engineer.
Work with human resources to develop and implement training programs for production staff, ensuring they have the skills to perform their jobs effectively.
Ensure compliance with all safety regulations and company policies.
Create detailed drawings of production systems and equipment to aid in troubleshooting and maintenance.
Develop and maintain documentation for all production processes, including process flow diagrams, work instructions, and training materials.
ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:
Optimize work sequencing and workflow through machines/work centers.
Develop and issue Manufacturing Engineering policies and procedures.
Provide budgeting information and project updates/status to management.
Design layouts and line flow.
Coordinate implementation of approved facility changes with Manufacturing.
Conduct workflow, capacity, and throughput analyses.
Conduct cost analysis as required.
Champion and apply Lean Tools (5S, Kaizen, Root Cause Analysis); monitor effectiveness.
Participate in and facilitate Kaizen events and train others on how to facilitate them.
Measure Lean implementation results.
Execute and promote problem-solving at all levels of the organization.
Office computer program literacy, and experience using calipers, micrometers, and measuring equipment.
cond_0294.requirements:
Minimum Requirements:
Bachelor's degree in mechanical, industrial, electrical, avionics, or manufacturing engineering
Minimum of 5 years of manufacturing engineering experience
Preferred Requirements:
Familiarity with Lean Manufacturing tools and principles (5S, Kaizen, Root Cause Analysis)
Experience conducting time studies, capacity analyses, and workflow analyses
Experience developing SOPs, work instructions, and training materials
Experience using calipers, micrometers, and other measuring equipment
cond_0294.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.
cond_0294.values: We value excellence and take pride in delivering strong results. We aim to hold a high standard in our work and in the outcomes we create.

cond_0329.intro: Your mission is to design, develop, and implement efficient production systems that will improve profitability and safety. You will use your years of experience with production processes, process flow, capacity planning, inventory management, and Lean Manufacturing principles to increase efficiency. Your excellent problem-solving skills will help you troubleshoot issues within the facility, and your strong written and verbal communication skills will help you build trusting relationships with Maintenance, Manufacturing, Shipping/Receiving, and elsewhere in the company. People generally become stronger in this kind of manufacturing engineering work over time as they build hands-on experience and learn from real production challenges.
cond_0329.responsibilities:
PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITES:
Design, develop, and implement efficient production systems that optimize the use of resources and minimize waste.
Work closely with product engineering and production teams to identify areas of improvement and develop solutions to enhance productivity, quality, and cost.
Conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) on production issues to identify the underlying cause of problems and develop solutions to prevent recurrence.
Develop and maintain standard operating procedures (S&OPs) for all production processes and conduct time studies to identify bottlenecks and inefficiencies in the production process with the method engineer.
Work with human resources to develop and implement training programs for production staff to ensure they are equipped with the necessary skills to perform their jobs effectively.
Ensure compliance with all safety regulations and company policies.
Create detailed drawings of production systems and equipment to aid in troubleshooting and maintenance.
Develops and maintain documentation for all production processes, including process flow diagrams, work instructions, and training materials.
ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:
Optimize work sequencing and workflow through machines/work centers.
Develop and issue Manufacturing Engineering policies and procedures.
Provide budgeting information and project updates/status to management.
Design of layouts and line flow.
Coordinate implementation of approved facility changes with Manufacturing.
Conduct workflow, capacity, and throughput analyses.
Conduct cost analysis as required.
Champion and apply Lean Tools (5S, Kaizen, Root Cause Analysis); monitor effectiveness.
Participate and/or Facilitate Kaizen events and train others on how to facilitate them.
Measure Lean implementation results.
Execute and promote problem-solving at all levels of the organization.
Office computer program literacy, and experience using calipers, micrometers, and measuring equipment are required to perform the duties of this position.
cond_0329.requirements:
Minimum Requirements:
A bachelor's degree in mechanical, industrial, electrical, avionics, or manufacturing engineering
Minimum of 5 years of manufacturing engineering experience

cond_0363.intro: Your mission is to design, develop, and implement efficient production systems that will improve profitability and safety. You will use your years of experience with production processes, process flow, capacity planning, inventory management, and Lean Manufacturing principles to increase efficiency. Your excellent problem-solving skills will help you troubleshoot issues within the facility, and your strong written and verbal communication skills will help you build trusting relationships with Maintenance, Manufacturing, Shipping/Receiving, and elsewhere in the company.
cond_0363.responsibilities:
PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITES:
Design, develop, and implement efficient production systems that optimize the use of resources and minimize waste.
Work closely with product engineering and production teams to identify areas of improvement and develop solutions to enhance productivity, quality, and cost.
Conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) on production issues to identify the underlying cause of problems and develop solutions to prevent recurrence.
Develop and maintain standard operating procedures (S&OPs) for all production processes and conduct time studies to identify bottlenecks and inefficiencies in the production process with the method engineer.
Work with human resources to develop and implement training programs for production staff to ensure they are equipped with the necessary skills to perform their jobs effectively.
Ensure compliance with all safety regulations and company policies.
Create detailed drawings of production systems and equipment to aid in troubleshooting and maintenance.
Develops and maintain documentation for all production processes, including process flow diagrams, work instructions, and training materials.
ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:
Optimize work sequencing and workflow through machines/work centers.
Develop and issue Manufacturing Engineering policies and procedures.
Provide budgeting information and project updates/status to management.
Design of layouts and line flow.
Coordinate implementation of approved facility changes with Manufacturing.
Conduct workflow, capacity, and throughput analyses.
Conduct cost analysis as required.
Champion and apply Lean Tools (5S, Kaizen, Root Cause Analysis); monitor effectiveness.
Participate and/or Facilitate Kaizen events and train others on how to facilitate them.
Measure Lean implementation results.
Execute and promote problem-solving at all levels of the organization.
Office computer program literacy, and experience using calipers, micrometers, and measuring equipment are required to perform the duties of this position.
cond_0363.requirements:
Minimum Requirements:
A bachelor's degree in mechanical, industrial, electrical, avionics, or manufacturing engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Preferred Requirements:
Around 5 years of manufacturing engineering experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

Your problem-solving skills will help you troubleshoot issues within the facility, and your strong written and verbal communication skills will help you build trusting relationships with Maintenance, Manufacturing, Shipping/Receiving, and others across the company.
cond_0384.responsibilities:
PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:
Design, develop, and implement efficient production systems that optimize the use of resources and minimize waste.
Work closely with product engineering and production teams daily to identify areas of improvement and develop solutions to enhance productivity, quality, and cost.
Conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) on production issues to identify the underlying cause of problems and develop solutions to prevent recurrence.
Develop and maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs) for all production processes and conduct time studies to identify bottlenecks and inefficiencies, working directly with the method engineer.
Work with human resources to develop and implement training programs for production staff, ensuring they have the skills to perform their jobs effectively.
Ensure compliance with all safety regulations and company policies.
Create detailed drawings of production systems and equipment to aid in troubleshooting and maintenance.
Develop and maintain documentation for all production processes, including process flow diagrams, work instructions, and training materials.
ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:
Optimize work sequencing and workflow through machines/work centers.
Develop and issue Manufacturing Engineering policies and procedures.
Provide budgeting information and project updates/status to management.
Design layouts and line flow.
Coordinate implementation of approved facility changes with Manufacturing.
Conduct workflow, capacity, and throughput analyses.
Conduct cost analysis as required.
Champion and apply Lean Tools (5S, Kaizen, Root Cause Analysis); monitor effectiveness.
Participate in and facilitate Kaizen events and train others on how to facilitate them.
Measure Lean implementation results.
Execute and promote problem-solving at all levels of the organization.
Office computer program literacy, and experience using calipers, micrometers, and measuring equipment.
cond_0384.requirements:
Minimum Requirements:
Bachelor's degree in mechanical, industrial, electrical, avionics, or manufacturing engineering
Minimum of 5 years of manufacturing engineering experience
Preferred Requirements:
Familiarity with Lean Manufacturing tools and principles (5S, Kaizen, Root Cause Analysis)
Experience conducting time studies, capacity analyses, and workflow analyses
Experience developing SOPs, work instructions, and training materials
Experience using calipers, micrometers, and other measuring equipment

You will use your years of experience with production processes, process flow, capacity planning, inventory management, and Lean Manufacturing principles to increase efficiency. Your excellent problem-solving skills will help you troubleshoot issues within the facility, and your strong written and verbal communication skills will help you build trusting relationships with Maintenance, Manufacturing, Shipping/Receiving, and elsewhere in the company.
cond_0407.responsibilities:
PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITES:
Design, develop, and implement efficient production systems that optimize the use of resources and minimize waste.
Work closely with product engineering and production teams to identify areas of improvement and develop solutions to enhance productivity, quality, and cost.
Conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) on production issues to identify the underlying cause of problems and develop solutions to prevent recurrence.
Develop and maintain standard operating procedures (S&OPs) for all production processes and conduct time studies to identify bottlenecks and inefficiencies in the production process with the method engineer.
Work with human resources to develop and implement training programs for production staff to ensure they are equipped with the necessary skills to perform their jobs effectively.
Ensure compliance with all safety regulations and company policies.
Create detailed drawings of production systems and equipment to aid in troubleshooting and maintenance.
Develops and maintain documentation for all production processes, including process flow diagrams, work instructions, and training materials.
ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:
Optimize work sequencing and workflow through machines/work centers.
Develop and issue Manufacturing Engineering policies and procedures.
Provide budgeting information and project updates/status to management.
Design of layouts and line flow.
Coordinate implementation of approved facility changes with Manufacturing.
Conduct workflow, capacity, and throughput analyses.
Conduct cost analysis as required.
Champion and apply Lean Tools (5S, Kaizen, Root Cause Analysis); monitor effectiveness.
Participate and/or Facilitate Kaizen events and train others on how to facilitate them.
Measure Lean implementation results.
Execute and promote problem-solving at all levels of the organization.
Office computer program literacy, and experience using calipers, micrometers, and measuring equipment are required to perform the duties of this position.
cond_0407.requirements: Bachelor's degree in mechanical, industrial, electrical, avionics, or manufacturing engineering required; advanced degree strongly preferred. Minimum 5 years of demonstrated expertise in manufacturing engineering.

Design, develop, and implement efficient production systems that optimize the use of resources and minimize waste.

Conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) on production issues to identify the underlying cause of problems and develop solutions to prevent recurrence.
Develop and maintain standard operating procedures (S&OPs) for all production processes and conduct time studies to identify bottlenecks and inefficiencies in the production process with the method engineer.

Ensure compliance with all safety regulations and company policies.
Create detailed drawings of production systems and equipment to aid in troubleshooting and maintenance.
Develops and maintain documentation for all production processes, including process flow diagrams, work instructions, and training materials.

Optimize work sequencing and workflow through machines/work centers.
Develop and issue Manufacturing Engineering policies and procedures.
Provide budgeting information and project updates/status to management.
Design of layouts and line flow.
Coordinate implementation of approved facility changes with Manufacturing.
Conduct workflow, capacity, and throughput analyses.
Conduct cost analysis as required.
Champion and apply Lean Tools (5S, Kaizen, Root Cause Analysis); monitor effectiveness.
Participate and/or Facilitate Kaizen events and train others on how to facilitate them.
Measure Lean implementation results.
Execute and promote problem-solving at all levels of the organization.
Office computer program literacy, and experience using calipers, micrometers, and measuring equipment are required to perform the duties of this position.

cond_0629.intro: Your mission is to design, develop, and implement efficient production systems that will improve profitability and safety. You will draw on your experience with production processes, process flow, capacity planning, inventory management, and Lean Manufacturing principles to drive efficiency. Your problem-solving skills will help you troubleshoot issues within the facility, and your written and verbal communication skills will help you build trusting relationships with Maintenance, Manufacturing, Shipping/Receiving, and elsewhere in the company.
cond_0629.responsibilities:
PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:
Design, develop, and implement efficient production systems that optimize the use of resources and minimize waste.
Lead collaboration with product engineering and production teams to identify areas of improvement and develop solutions to enhance productivity, quality, and cost.
Conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) on production issues to determine the underlying cause of problems and develop solutions to prevent recurrence.
Develop and maintain standard operating procedures (S&OPs) for all production processes and execute time studies to identify bottlenecks and inefficiencies in the production process with the method engineer.
Direct the development and implementation of training programs with human resources for production staff to ensure they are equipped with the necessary skills to perform their jobs effectively.
Ensure compliance with all safety regulations and company policies.
Create detailed drawings of production systems and equipment to aid in troubleshooting and maintenance.
Develop and maintain documentation for all production processes, including process flow diagrams, work instructions, and training materials.
ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:
Optimize work sequencing and workflow through machines/work centers.
Develop and issue Manufacturing Engineering policies and procedures.
Provide budgeting information and project updates/status to management.
Direct the design of layouts and line flow.
Own implementation of approved facility changes with Manufacturing.
Conduct workflow, capacity, and throughput analyses.
Conduct cost analysis as required.
Champion and apply Lean Tools (5S, Kaizen, Root Cause Analysis); monitor effectiveness.
Lead and facilitate Kaizen events and train others on how to facilitate them.
Measure Lean implementation results.
Execute and promote problem-solving at all levels of the organization.
Office computer program literacy, and experience using calipers, micrometers, and measuring equipment are required to perform the duties of this position.
